title: An expiry is judged at the latest time the history has reached
note: D-2026-168. Each mutation puts one reader, writer, snapshot or restatement back on the record's own wall time (or drops the second reader's restated check of a decision's policy). tests/test_history_time.py sets the clock back past an expiry the history had reached, on the write path and as a record a writer without the rule wrote, each with a control; tests/test_policy_binding.py holds the second reader's decision restatements; tests/test_decision_proof.py the proof's policy check.

mutations.find: return wall_time if latest is None else max(latest, wall_time)
mutations.rationale: D-2026-168: the shared rule judges at the record's own wall time: every reader is beaten by a clock set back
